title: Tocic - Chatbot Table of Content – Get this Extension for 🦊 Firefox (en-US)
excerpt: Download Tocic - Chatbot Table of Content for Firefox. Adds a table-of-contents navigator to Grok, Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT conversations.
content_html:
A browser extension that adds a table of contents (TOC) navigator to web-based Chatbot conversations. Making long conversation easier to navigate

Log in to rate this extension

There are no ratings yet

Required permissions:

  • Access browser tabs
  • Access your data for all websites

Optional permissions:

  • Access your data for all websites

Data collection:

  • The developer says this extension doesn't require data collection.
